## Research opportunities

I welcome enquiries from motivated candidates interested in low-temperature plasma physics, optical diagnostics, atomic processes, machine learning, and plasma applications.

For enquiries about internships, doctoral or postdoctoral research, please email your CV and a short description of your interests. This is an invitation to enquire; specific funded vacancies will be announced separately.

## Collaboration

Please contact me to discuss experimental, theoretical, or industry collaborations related to our research themes.
